description: June 9 birthday meaning: Gemini decan 2, birthday number 9, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a June 9 birthday falls in Gemini, in the second decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 9. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Gemini is mutable and air.

sections.heading: June 9 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: What does generosity look like in an air sign? On the 9th of June it often looks like sharing information, contacts and encouragement freely. Gemini is eighteen degrees along, Venus sub-rules the decan, and 9 is the number of compassion and completion. This birthday is often described as a connector of people for reasons well beyond self-interest.

On June 9 the Sun usually sits at about 18° Gemini, in the second decan, where Venus is the sub-ruler alongside Mercury. Venus, which governs Libra, colours the middle decan of Gemini, giving the Twins' restless mind a social and aesthetic polish. Early-June birthdays are commonly linked with charming conversationalists who notice how something is said as much as what is said. They tend to enjoy collaboration, matching ideas or people, and finding the elegant version of an argument. The Libran thread can make conflict uncomfortable, so a sharp opinion may be softened until it quietly disappears. Their strength is diplomacy with substance: helping groups talk to each other while keeping the exchange genuinely curious rather than merely pleasant.

sections.heading: June 9 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 9th, your birthday number is 9, the last and broadest of the single digits. Numerologists see the birth day as a secondary number that describes a natural gift. The 9 is traditionally associated with compassion, idealism and a wide view of humanity, perhaps because it contains something of every number before it. Those with this birthday often find themselves helping, teaching or creating for audiences beyond their own circle. Letting go can be a recurring theme for 9s, along with learning that finishing one chapter makes space for a better one.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one June 9 birthday to the next: it is 22 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22.

sections.heading: Born on June 9: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A June birthday falls at the height of northern summer, around the longest days of the year, while in the southern hemisphere it marks the darkest stretch near the winter solstice. Gemini covers most of the month, with Cancer beginning around June 21. June is month 6 in numerology, a number of care, responsibility and home, which foreshadows the Cancerian turn at the month's end. June 9 is the 160th day of the year (161st in a leap year). By June 22, 13 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Cancer.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by June 9, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on June 9 include Johnny Depp (1963), Natalie Portman (1981) and Bertha von Suttner (1843).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is June 9?
faq.answer: June 9 is Gemini in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Gemini, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on June 9?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On June 9 the Life Path is 22 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 9 for everyone born on the 9th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on June 9?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a June 9 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on June 9?
faq.answer: June 9 is also the birthday of Johnny Depp (1963), Natalie Portman (1981) and Bertha von Suttner (1843). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
